CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse._pro.name: CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse._proof_1
CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse._pro.type:

CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse.cong.type:

  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (rev rev_1 : E → Prop),
      rev = rev_1 → ∀ {inst : DecidablePred rev} [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev_1], m.reverse rev = m_1.reverse rev_1

CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.reverse.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop)
  [inst : DecidablePred rev],
  m.reverse rev =
    { tail := fun e => if rev e then m.head e else m.tail e, head := fun e => if rev e then m.tail e else m.head e,
      distinct := ⋯, owner := m.owner }

CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces.tail.type: {N : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → {B : Type u_3} → CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → E → N

CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 →
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
        (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
      0

CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
      (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i))

CFDLean.Assembly.encoded_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.encoded_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.encoded_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ V U (-S)) =
    -CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S)

CFDLean.Assembly.global_balance._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Assembly.global_balance._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Assembly.global_balance._simp_1_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {f : ι → R} {s : Finset ι} {x : M}, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • x = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • x

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.type: {N : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → {B : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq N] → CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → N → E → ℝ

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.congr_simp
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.congr_simp.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N]
  (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (i i_1 : N),
      i = i_1 → ∀ (e e_1 : E), e = e_1 → CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m_1 i_1 e_1

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = (if m.tail e = i then 1 else 0) - if m.head e = i then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_neg_one.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_neg_one
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_neg_one.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = -1 ↔ i = m.head e

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_one.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_one
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_one.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 1 ↔ i = m.tail e

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.head e) e = -1

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), m.tail e ≠ i → m.head e ≠ i → CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (rev : E → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev] (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence (m.reverse rev) i e =
    if rev e then -CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e else CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] {d : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (i : N) (e : E) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • v = (if m.tail e = i then v else 0) - if m.head e = i then v else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E), ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.tail e) e = 1

CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.name: CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect
CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
          ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    if m.tail e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))
    else
      if m.head e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (-S e))
      else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_1
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (S + T)) =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S) + CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_2
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (a • S)) =
    (RingHom.id ℝ) a • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            {d : ℕ} →
              CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector d) → (B → CFDLean.Vector d) → N → CFDLean.Vector d

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ} (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (f f_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector d),
      f = f_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector d),
          g = g_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
              i = i_1 →
                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin d),
                  a = a_1 → CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i a = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m_1 f_1 g_1 i_1 a_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • f e + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (L : CFDLean.Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] CFDLean.Vector k)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => L (f e)) (fun b => L (g b)) i = L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e with m.tail e = i, f e - ∑ e with m.head e = i, f e + ∑ b with m.owner b = i, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (e.symm j)) (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => if rev e then -f e else f e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
        ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e)

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  S e = 0 → CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i = ∑ b, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b)
      (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun j => U (n.symm j)) fun j => S (e.symm j))
      (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev)
      (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer (m.reverse rev) γ U fun e => if rev e then -S e else S e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismat.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismatchingData.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismat.type:
∀ (F : Finset (Fin 4)),
  CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismatchingData F =
    if
        F =
          CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard
            CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch then
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 3
    else CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.obliqu.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.oblique_all_symmetry_rest
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.obliqu.type:
∀ (V : Finset (Fin 4) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.oblique 2
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction) V
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1) i =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.pressu.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.pressure_force_retained
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.pressu.type:
∑ i,
    CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.onePatchInterface 2
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 3)
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis)
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis) i =
  ![0, 1, 0, 0, 0]

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.same_f.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.same_face_area
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.same_f.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b c : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M c → M.boundaryArea b = M.boundaryArea c

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.single.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.single_face_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.single.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b₀ : M.Boundary),
      (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
          CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b₀ →
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b =
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)) →
        CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) (M.interfaces.owner b₀) =
          CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b₀ -
            (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b₀)

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard_all_wall_rest
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.type:
∀ (V : Finset (Fin 4) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard 2 (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall) V
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1) i =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard_mixed_common
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.type:
∀ (q : ℝ) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard 2
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mixedKinds (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1)
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1) i =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard_wall_tangent
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standa.type:
∀ (q : ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mixedKinds b ≠
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1).momentum
        (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.boundaryArea b) =
      0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.transp.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.transported_nonzero
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.transp.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual
    (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.interfaces.reindex (Equiv.swap 0 1)
      (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge01 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge02)
      (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
    2
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mixedKinds
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard
        CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismatchingData
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1)
    (fun e =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.edgeArea
        ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge01 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge02)) e))
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.boundaryArea
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    1 =
  ![-1 / 12, -1 / 6, 0, 0, -1 / 3]

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKin.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKin.type:
∀ (F : Finset (Fin 5)),
  CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds F =
    if
        F =
          CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells
            CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall then
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall
    else
      if
          F =
            CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells
              CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoSymmetry then
        CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction
      else CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_cell_all_wall_energy
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.type:
∀ (U : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (V : Finset (Fin 5) → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i,
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells 2
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall) V U i 4 =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_cell_all_wall_mass
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.type:
∀ (U : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (V : Finset (Fin 5) → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i,
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells 2
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall) V U i 0 =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_cell_common
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.type:
∀ (q : ℝ) (i : Fin 5),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells 2 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1)
      i =
    0

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_cell_corner
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall =
    CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoSymmetry ∧
  CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall =
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen ∧
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
          CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall =
        CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall ∧
      CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
            CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoSymmetry =
          CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction ∧
        CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
            CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen =
          CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_wa.name: CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_wall_tangent
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_wa.type:
∀ (q : ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds b ≠
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1).momentum
        (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.boundaryArea b) =
      0

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds.eq_.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds.eq_.type:
∀ (F : Finset (Fin 4)),
  CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds F =
    if F = CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wallPatch then
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall
    else CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixed_corner.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixed_corner
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixed_corner.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wallPatch =
    CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.openPatch ∧
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds
        CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wallPatch =
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall ∧
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds
        CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.openPatch =
      CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving.eq_1.type: ∀ (q p : ℝ), CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q p = { density := 1, momentum := ![q, 0, 0], energy := p + q ^ 2 / 2 }

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_admissi.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_admissible
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_admissi.type: ∀ (q p : ℝ), 0 < p → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q p)

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_average.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_averageVelocity
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_average.type:
∀ (q p r : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q p))
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q r)) =
    ![q, 0, 0]

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_enthalp.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_enthalpy
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_enthalp.type:
∀ (q p r : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q p))
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q r)) =
    p + r + q ^ 2 / 2

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_pressur.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_pressure
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_pressur.type: ∀ (q p : ℝ), CFDLean.Conservative.pressure 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q p) = p

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_exterior
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_.type:
∀ q ≤ -2,
  CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 1)
      (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 3) CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode
      (CFDLean.physicalFlux 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 3) CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis)

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_owner
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving_upwind_.type:
∀ (q : ℝ),
  2 ≤ q →
    CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 1)
        (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 3) CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis =
      CFDLean.Coordinates.encode
        (CFDLean.physicalFlux 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving q 1) CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis)

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.oblique_physic.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.oblique_physical
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.oblique_physic.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer 2 CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.obliqueOwner CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.obliqueArea =
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode
    (CFDLean.physicalFlux 2 CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.obliqueOwner CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.obliqueArea)

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.open_patch_tra.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.open_patch_transfer
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.open_patch_tra.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard 2 CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds
    (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1)
    CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.openPatch =
  ![0, -1 / 6, 0, 0, 0]

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.owner_sampling.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.owner_sampling_differs
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.owner_sampling.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1) CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis ≠
  CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer
    ((6 * CFDLean.Conservative.pressure 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1) +
          CFDLean.Conservative.pressure 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 2) +
        CFDLean.Conservative.pressure 2 (CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 4)) /
      8)
    CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.axis

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflected_aver.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflected_averages
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflected_aver.type:
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedOwner)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedExterior) =
    0 ∧
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedOwner)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedExterior) =
      4 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedOwner)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.reflectedExterior) =
      2

CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wall_patch_tra.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wall_patch_transfer
CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wall_patch_tra.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.standard 2 CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.mixedKinds
    (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.moving 0 1)
    CFDLean.Boundary.Controls.wallPatch =
  ![0, 0, 0, -1 / 6, 0]

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.casesOn.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.casesOn
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.casesOn.type:
{motive : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → Sort u} →
  (t : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
    motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall →
      motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction →
        motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → motive t

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElim.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElim
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElim.type:
{motive : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → Sort u} →
  (ctorIdx : ℕ) →
    (t : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) → ctorIdx = t.ctorIdx → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElimType ctorIdx → motive t

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElimType.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElimType
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.ctorElimType.type: {motive : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → Sort u} → ℕ → Sort (max 1 u)

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTr.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction.elim
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTr.type:

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusion
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusion.type: {P : Sort v✝} → {x y : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind} → x = y → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusionType P x y

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusionType.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusionType
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.noConfusionType.type: Sort v✝ → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → Sort v✝

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExterior.type:

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.rec.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.rec
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.rec.type:

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.recOn.name: CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.recOn
CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.recOn.type:

CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall.elim.type:

CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_range.name: CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_range
CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_range.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n),
  (∃ b, CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = F ∧ M.interfaces.owner b = i) ↔ M.faceCount F = 1 ∧ i ∈ F

CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_unique.name: CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_unique
CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_unique.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b c : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M c →
    M.interfaces.owner b = M.interfaces.owner c → b = c

CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.name: CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer
CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
        ℝ →
          (B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
            (B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
              (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.eq_.name: CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.eq_.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (b : B),
  CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b = CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ (k b) (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.constructed_transfer_re.name: CFDLean.Boundary.constructed_transfer_reindex
CFDLean.Boundary.constructed_transfer_re.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : B'),
  CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (b.symm x)) (fun x => V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (fun x => T (b.symm x)) j =
    CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T (b.symm j)

CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._pr.name: CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._proof_1
CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._pr.type: ∀ (x y : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind), x.ctorIdx = y.ctorIdx → x = y

CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._pr.name: CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._proof_2
CFDLean.Boundary.instDecidableEqKind._pr.type: ∀ (x y : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind), ¬x.ctorIdx = y.ctorIdx → x = y → False

CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual.name: CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m →
    ℝ →
      (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
        (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
          (Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → Fin n → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.name: CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea)
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U) i

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i =
        ∑ b,
          if M.interfaces.owner b = i then
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b -
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)
          else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

CFDLean.Boundary.momentum_coordinate.name: CFDLean.Boundary.momentum_coordinate
CFDLean.Boundary.momentum_coordinate.type: ∀ (f : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (j : Fin 3), (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode f).momentum j = f j.castSucc.succ

CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior
CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) →
    (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Conservative 3

CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = V (CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior_coherent.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior_coherent
CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior_coherent.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b c : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M c →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V c

CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind
CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind

CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = k (CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind_coherent.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind_coherent
CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind_coherent.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (b c : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M c →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k c

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) →
    ℝ →
      (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
        (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
          (Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
    CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_prescribe.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_prescribed
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_prescribe.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
      CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)
        (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_symmetry.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_symmetry
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_symmetry.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
      CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_wall.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_wall
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_wall.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
      CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTr.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTr.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V T)

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_consistency.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_consistency
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_consistency.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ V U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 ≤ a →
    CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V (a • T) =
      a • CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exter.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exterior
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exter.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        T ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) ≤
              -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) →
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T =
              CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ V T)

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        T ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) ≤
              CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) →
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T =
              CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3), CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V 0 = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : ℝ) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer p T = ![0, p * T 0, p * T 1, p * T 2, 0]

CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.name: CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace
CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Boundary → Finset (Fin n)

CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = M.faceID (↑b).1

CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.name: CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_difference
CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates)
  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b - h b else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual
CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
              ℝ →
                (B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
                  (B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
                    (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
                      (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.cong.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.congr_simp
CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.cong.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (γ γ_1 : ℝ),
      γ = γ_1 →
        ∀ (k k_1 : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind),
          k = k_1 →
            ∀ (V V_1 : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
              V = V_1 →
                ∀ (U U_1 : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
                  U = U_1 →
                    ∀ (S S_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector 3),
                      S = S_1 →
                        ∀ (T T_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
                          T = T_1 →
                            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
                              i = i_1 →
                                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin 5),
                                  a = a_1 →
                                    CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i a =
                                      CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m_1 γ_1 k_1 V_1 U_1 S_1 T_1 i_1 a_1

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_closed
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 → CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)) +
      ∑ b,
        if m.owner b = i then
          CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b - (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)
        else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defec.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defect
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defec.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
        CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i))

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_ba.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_ba.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 5),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i j = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b j

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balan.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balan.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i 4 =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) 4
      else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i 0 =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) 0
      else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i =
    (∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
          CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)
        else 0) +
      ∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0
        else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j
      else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b)) * T b j

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_reindex
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (b.symm x)) (fun x => V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (fun x => S (e.symm x)) (fun x => T (b.symm x)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.type:
ℝ →
  CFDLean.Boundary.Kind →
    CFDLean.Conservative 3 → CFDLean.Conservative 3 → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall U V T = CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_2.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_2
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_2.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction U V T = CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_3.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_3
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.eq_3.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe U V T =
    CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.match_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.match_1
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer.match_1.type:
(motive : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind → Sort u_1) →
  (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
    (Unit → motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.slipWall) →
      (Unit → motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction) →
        (Unit → motive CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) → motive k

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (k ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0) →
    (k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V = U) →
      CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) T

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T 4 =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T 4
    else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T 0 =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T 0
    else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T)).momentum j =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T)).momentum j
    else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T j

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T =
    (if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T
      else 0) +
      if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0 else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) T

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (S + T) = CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U S + CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 4 = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
    CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 < U.density →
    T ≠ 0 →
      (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
        CFDLean.dot (fun i => U.momentum i / U.density) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) = 0)

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 0 = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i =
    CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T i

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3), CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → 0 < CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (a • T) = a • CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1
CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U = (0 < U.density ∧ 0 < CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U)

CFDLean.Conservative.casesOn.name: CFDLean.Conservative.casesOn
CFDLean.Conservative.casesOn.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Conservative d → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.Conservative d) →
      ((density : ℝ) →
          (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) →
            (energy : ℝ) → motive { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Conservative d

CFDLean.Conservative.mk._flat_ctor.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk._flat_ctor
CFDLean.Conservative.mk._flat_ctor.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Conservative d

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.inj.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.inj
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.inj.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {density : ℝ} {momentum : CFDLean.Vector d} {energy density_1 : ℝ} {momentum_1 : CFDLean.Vector d}
  {energy_1 : ℝ},
  { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } =
      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 } →
    density = density_1 ∧ momentum = momentum_1 ∧ energy = energy_1

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy density_1 : ℝ) (momentum_1 : CFDLean.Vector d)
  (energy_1 : ℝ),
  ({ density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } =
      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 }) =
    (density = density_1 ∧ momentum = momentum_1 ∧ energy = energy_1)

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.noConfusion
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.noConfusion.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {density : ℝ} →
      {momentum : CFDLean.Vector d} →
        {energy density' : ℝ} →
          {momentum' : CFDLean.Vector d} →
            {energy' : ℝ} →
              { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } =
                  { density := density', momentum := momentum', energy := energy' } →
                (density = density' → momentum ≍ momentum' → energy = energy' → P) → P

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy : ℝ),
  sizeOf { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } = 1 + sizeOf density + sizeOf energy

CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusion
CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {d : ℕ} →
    {t : CFDLean.Conservative d} →
      {d' : ℕ} → {t' : CFDLean.Conservative d'} → d = d' → t ≍ t' → CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusionType P t t'

CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusionType.name: CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusionType
CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusionType.type: Sort u → {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Conservative d → {d' : ℕ} → CFDLean.Conservative d' → Sort u

CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1
CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U = (γ - 1) * (U.energy - CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum / (2 * U.density))

CFDLean.Conservative.rec.name: CFDLean.Conservative.rec
CFDLean.Conservative.rec.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Conservative d → Sort u} →
    ((density : ℝ) →
        (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) →
          (energy : ℝ) → motive { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy }) →
      (t : CFDLean.Conservative d) → motive t

CFDLean.Conservative.recOn.name: CFDLean.Conservative.recOn
CFDLean.Conservative.recOn.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Conservative d → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.Conservative d) →
      ((density : ℝ) →

          (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b) + if b = b₀ then δ else 0) (↑b₀).2 =

          (CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.boundaryArea b) +
        if b = CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standardBoundary then ![1, 0, 0, 0, 0] else 0)

  {M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m} →

      (t : M.Conforming) →
        ((uniqueCells : Function.Injective M.cellNodes) →
            (injectiveUsed : ∀ (a b : Fin n), M.Used a → M.Used b → M.position a = M.position b → a = b) →

                  ∀ (t u : Fin m),
                    t ≠ u →
                      (convexHull ℝ) (Set.range (M.points t)) ∩ (convexHull ℝ) (Set.range (M.points u)) =
                        (convexHull ℝ) (M.position '' ↑(M.cellNodes t ∩ M.cellNodes u))) →
                (faceMultiplicity : ∀ (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceCount F ≤ 2) →
                  (oppositeSides :
                      ∀ (a b : M.Occurrence),
                        a ≠ b →
                          M.faceID a = M.faceID b →
                            0 <
                              CFDLean.dot (M.faceArea a) (M.position (M.oppositeNode b) - M.position (M.baseNode a))) →
                    motive ⋯) →
          motive t
