CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_nonneg.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_nonneg
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_nonneg.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), 0 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * ↑d * M.V i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.ne_row._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.nu_ee.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.nu_ee
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.nu_ee.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (i k : ι),
      CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.e i k) (M.e i k) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.outer_psd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.outer_psd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.outer_psd.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → ∀ (e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), (c • CFDLean.Num.outer e e).PosSemidef

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.psd_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.psd_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Dg7.psd_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ c k) → ∀ (e : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d), (∑ k, c k • CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k)).PosSemidef

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.c_outer_su.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.c_outer_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.c_outer_su.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.c i k) (M.e i k) = M.V i • 1

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cell_one.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cell_one
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cell_one.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (T : C) (a : Fin (d + 1)), ∑ b, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.g T b) (M.pos ((M.vert T) b) - M.pos ((M.vert T) a)) = 1

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot e e ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e ∧
      (CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 = CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e →
        y = (CFDLean.Num.dot y e / CFDLean.Num.dot e e) • e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T * M.m T * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) (M.e i k) = M.mu i k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c k i) (M.e i k) = -M.mu i k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),
  -∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, -f x

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_ite_le.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_ite_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_ite_le.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : Prop) [inst : Decidable p] (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (if p then u else 0) v = if p then CFDLean.Num.dot u v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_le_len.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_le_len
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_le_len.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot y e ≤ CFDLean.Num.len y * CFDLean.Num.len e

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_self_n.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_self_nonneg
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_self_n.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), 0 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot u u

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_l.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (c • u) v = c * CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_r.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_r
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_smul_r.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (c • v) = c * CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sub_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sub_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sub_l.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (u - v) w = CFDLean.Num.dot u w - CFDLean.Num.dot v w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sum_le.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sum_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_sum_le.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {β : Type} (s : Finset β) (f : β → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (∑ j ∈ s, f j) v = ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.dot (f j) v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_unit.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_unit
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_unit.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit u) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit u) = if CFDLean.Num.len u = 0 then 0 else 1

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_self.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_self
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_self.type: ∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i : ι), M.e i i = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_zero_n_z.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_zero_n_zero
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.e_zero_n_z.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), M.e i k = 0 → M.n i k = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.eq_zero_of.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.eq_zero_of_dot_self
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.eq_zero_of.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u u = 0 → u = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.gdot.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.gdot
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.gdot.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (T : C) (a b c : Fin (d + 1)),
      CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T a) (M.pos ((M.vert T) b) - M.pos ((M.vert T) c)) =
        (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = c then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_mul_se.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_mul_self
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_mul_se.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.len u * CFDLean.Num.len u = CFDLean.Num.dot u u

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_smul'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_smul'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.len_smul'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.len (c • u) = |c| * CFDLean.Num.len u

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.m_pos.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.m_pos
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.m_pos.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C), 0 < M.m T

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_nonneg.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_nonneg
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_nonneg.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), 0 ≤ M.mu i k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_symm.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_symm
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.mu_symm.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι),
  M.mu k i = M.mu i k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.n_dot_e.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.n_dot_e
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.n_dot_e.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * M.mu i k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._simp_1_8
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_len_e._.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_term.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_term
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.nu_term.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (i k : ι),
      CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) *
          CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k)) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_ite_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_ite_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_ite_.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : Prop) [inst : Decidable p] (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.outer (if p then u else 0) v = if p then CFDLean.Num.outer u v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_neg_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_neg_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_neg_.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.outer u (-v) = -CFDLean.Num.outer u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.outer (c • u) v = c • CFDLean.Num.outer u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_smul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.outer u (c • v) = c • CFDLean.Num.outer u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.outer (u - v) w = CFDLean.Num.outer u w - CFDLean.Num.outer v w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sub_.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.outer u (v - w) = CFDLean.Num.outer u v - CFDLean.Num.outer u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sum_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sum_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.outer_sum_.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {β : Type} (s : Finset β) (f : β → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.outer (∑ j ∈ s, f j) v = ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.outer (f j) v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.pos_ne.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.pos_ne
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.pos_ne.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C) (a b : Fin (d + 1)), a ≠ b → M.pos ((M.vert T) b) - M.pos ((M.vert T) a) ≠ 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (y - t • e) (y - t • e) =
    CFDLean.Num.dot y y - 2 * t * CFDLean.Num.dot y e + t ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot e e

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f g : ι → G),
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.quad._simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  ∑ i, M.V i = M.volΩ

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._simp_1_8
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.sum_V._sim.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_eq_if.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_eq_iff
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_eq_if.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (e = 0 → y = 0) →
    (CFDLean.Num.len y * CFDLean.Num.len e * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot y e ↔
      ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ y = t • e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot y e ≤
    CFDLean.Num.len y * CFDLean.Num.len e * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  (M.Gtensor y i).trace =
    ∑ k,
      CFDLean.Num.len (y i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k))

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_oute.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_outer
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_oute.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), (CFDLean.Num.outer u v).trace = CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C), 0 ≤ M.ω T * M.m T

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_left.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) u = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_righ.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_righ.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) v = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3),
  T.edgeMat.det = CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x 1 - T.x 0) (T.x 2 - T.x 0)) (T.x 3 - T.x 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u v = CFDLean.Num.dot v u

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (-u) w = -CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (-w) = -CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (p : Fin d) (c : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (Pi.single p c) v = c * v p

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_left._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (u - v) w = CFDLean.Num.dot u w - CFDLean.Num.dot v w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (v - w) = CFDLean.Num.dot u v - CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •
          CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (T.x j - T.x 0) = (if a = j then 1 else 0) - if a = 0 then 1 else 0) →
    T.Nondeg ∧ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), T.grad a = G a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n}, (a.succ = b.succ) = (a = b)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot g w • CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v + CFDLean.Num.dot g u • CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w +
      CFDLean.Num.dot g v • CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w • g

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h =
    ![-CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1,
      CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2]

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 4) (k : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j (π k) = if ↑k < ↑j then h (π k) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin (3 + 1)), (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a = CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.type: ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i = Pi.single (π i) (h (π i))⁻¹

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i k : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h k) =
    if i = k then (h (π i))⁻¹ * (h (π i))⁻¹ else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 4),
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i)
          ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j - (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x 0) =
        if ↑i < ↑j then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.type:
∀ (p : Fin 4 → CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_facets.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_facets
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_facets.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι),
  (↑d * (↑d + 1)) • M.B i k =
    (if i = k then 2 else 1) • ∑ p, if i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then M.areaVec p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_row.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_row
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_row.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (i : ι), ∑ k, M.B i k = M.beta i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.beta_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.beta_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.beta_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    1 ≤ d → ∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_col.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_col
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_col.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (W : C → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ), (∀ (T : C), ∑ a, W T a = M.vol T) → ∀ (k : ι), ∑ i, M.cW W i k = M.beta k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_row.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_row
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_row.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (W : C → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (i : ι), ∑ k, M.cW W i k = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_swap.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_swap
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_swap.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (W : C → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (i k : ι),
  M.cW W k i = ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then (M.ω T * W T b) • M.g T a else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_col.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_col
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_col.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (k : ι), ∑ i, M.c i k = M.beta k

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_row.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_row
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.c_row.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (i : ι), ∑ k, M.c i k = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.card_facetNode.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.card_facetNodes
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.card_facetNode.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
  (M.facetNodes p).card = d

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_ite_r.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_ite_r
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_ite_r.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (P : Prop) [inst : Decidable P] (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot u (if P then v else 0) = if P then CFDLean.Num.dot u v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_smul_r'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_smul_r'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_smul_r'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (c • v) = c * CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_sum_r.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_sum_r
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.dot_sum_r.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {β : Type} (s : Finset β) (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (f : β → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot u (∑ x ∈ s, f x) = ∑ x ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.dot u (f x)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ),
  1 ≤ d →
    ∀ (s : Finset ι),
      s.card = d →
        ∀ (w F : ι → κ → ℝ),
          ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j * CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F j) =
            1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F i) -
              1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) * ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (F j - F i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity..type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.interior_zero.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.interior_zero
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.interior_zero.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    ∀ (P : Finset ι → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred P],
      (∑ p, if bd p = false ∧ P (M.facetNodes p) then M.areaVec p else 0) = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C),
  ∑ _a, M.m T = M.vol T

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_8
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.m_sum._simp_1_.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_fsum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_fsum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_fsum.type:
∀ {κ ι : Type} [Fintype κ] [inst : Fintype ι] {d : ℕ} (A : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (v : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  ∑ k, A.mulVec (v k) = A.mulVec (∑ k, v k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_ite.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_ite
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.mulVec_ite.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (A : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (P : Prop) [inst : Decidable P] (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  A.mulVec (if P then v else 0) = if P then A.mulVec v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_ite.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_ite
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_ite.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) (P : Prop) [inst_1 : Decidable P] (z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (if P then z else 0) = if P then CFDLean.Num.pairF x z else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_l.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (x - y) z = CFDLean.Num.pairF x z - CFDLean.Num.pairF y z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_r.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_r
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.pairF_sub_r.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (y - z) = CFDLean.Num.pairF x y - CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.split_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.split_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.split_bd.type:
∀ {C : Type} [inst : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} {X : Type} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup X] (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool)
  (Q : C × Fin (d + 1) → Prop) [inst_2 : DecidablePred Q] (f : C × Fin (d + 1) → X),
  (∑ p, if Q p then f p else 0) =
    (∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ Q p then f p else 0) + ∑ p, if bd p = false ∧ Q p then f p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.sum_bd_mem.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.sum_bd_mem
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.sum_bd_mem.type:
∀ {ι X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid X] (b : Bool) (s : Finset ι)
  (g : ι → X), (∑ i, if b = true ∧ i ∈ s then g i else 0) = if b = true then ∑ i ∈ s, g i else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.edge_co.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.edge_col
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.edge_co.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (β : Fin d), T.x β.succ - T.x 0 = fun α => T.edgeMat α β

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_dot_base
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (a b : Fin (d + 1)),
      CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (T.x b - T.x 0) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = 0 then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_dot_base._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_dot_base._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_do.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n}, (a.succ = b.succ) = (a = b)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_su.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_succ
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_su.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (γ : Fin d), T.grad γ.succ = fun α => T.edgeMat⁻¹ γ α

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_ze.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_zero
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.grad_ze.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), T.grad 0 = -∑ γ, fun α => T.edgeMat⁻¹ γ α

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.inv_mul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.inv_mul
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.inv_mul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (γ β : Fin d), ∑ α, T.edgeMat⁻¹ γ α * T.edgeMat α β = if γ = β then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.mul_inv.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.mul_inv
CFDLean.Num.Internal.SimplexCalc.mul_inv.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (β α : Fin d), ∑ γ, T.edgeMat β γ * T.edgeMat⁻¹ γ α = if β = α then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_production.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_production
CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_production.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (F : ι → ι → κ → ℝ) (w : ι → κ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i k : ι), F k i = -F i k) →
    -∑ i, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (∑ k, F i k) = 1 / 2 * ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w k - w i) (F i k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_sum_zero.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_sum_zero
CFDLean.Num.Internal.antisym_sum_zero.type: ∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] (F : ι → ι → κ → ℝ), (∀ (i k : ι), F k i = -F i k) → ∑ i, ∑ k, F i k = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_neg_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_neg_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_neg_l.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (-u) w = -CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_smul_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_smul_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_smul_l.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (c • u) w = c * CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sub_left'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sub_left'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sub_left'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (u - v) w = CFDLean.Num.dot u w - CFDLean.Num.dot v w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sum_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sum_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.dot_sum_right.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {ι : Type} (x : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot x (∑ k ∈ s, y k) = ∑ k ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.dot x (y k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.dualFacet2_eq.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.dualFacet2_eq
CFDLean.Num.Internal.dualFacet2_eq.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (i k : Fin 3), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dualFacet2 T i k = (T.vol / 3) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.grad_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.grad_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.grad_sum.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), ∑ a, T.grad a = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.localInterface_eq_g.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.localInterface_eq_grad
CFDLean.Num.Internal.localInterface_eq_g.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p →
    ∀ (i k : Fin 4),
      CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i k =
        ((CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).vol / 4) •
          ((CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).grad k - (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).grad i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_mulVec.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_mulVec
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_mulVec.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (w : κ → ℝ) (A : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (g : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF w (A.mulVec g) = ∑ r, ∑ α, w r * g α * A r α

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg'.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x z : κ → ℝ), CFDLean.Num.pairF x (-z) = -CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_neg_right.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x z : κ → ℝ), CFDLean.Num.pairF x (-z) = -CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_smul'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_smul'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_smul'.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x z : κ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), CFDLean.Num.pairF x (c • z) = c * CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sub_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sub_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sub_left.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (x - y) z = CFDLean.Num.pairF x z - CFDLean.Num.pairF y z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum.type:
∀ {κ ι : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (∑ k ∈ s, F k) = ∑ k ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF x (F k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.pairF_sum'.type:
∀ {κ ι : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (∑ k ∈ s, F k) = ∑ k ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF x (F k)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq
CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin 3),
      i ≠ k →
        ∃ σ,
          (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
            CFDLean.Num.rot90 (T.centroid - (1 / 2) • (T.x i + T.x k)) =
              (σ * (T.edgeMat.det / 6)) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first
CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first.type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : ℕ}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (k : ι) (f : C → Fin (d + 1) → Fin (d + 1) → X),
  (∑ i, ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then f T a b else 0) =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) b = k then f T a b else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second
CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second.type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : ℕ}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i : ι) (f : C → Fin (d + 1) → Fin (d + 1) → X),
  (∑ k, ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then f T a b else 0) =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i then f T a b else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_single.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_single

CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_eq_of_dots.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_eq_of_dots
CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_eq_of_dots.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      (∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) = CFDLean.Num.dot v (T.x a - T.x 0)) → u = v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_expand.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_expand
CFDLean.Num.Internal.vec_expand.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), u = ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) • T.grad a

CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced.name: CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced
CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced.type:
{ι C : Type} →
  [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → [LinearOrder ι] → [Fintype C] → CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3 → (C × Fin 4 → Bool) → Prop

CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced2.name: CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced2
CFDLean.Num.SideBalanced2.type:
{ι C : Type} →
  [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → [LinearOrder ι] → [Fintype C] → CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2 → (C × Fin 3 → Bool) → Prop

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∑ a, T.grad a = 0 ∧
      (∀ (a b c : Fin (d + 1)),
          CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (T.x b - T.x c) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = c then 1 else 0) ∧
        ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a) = 1 ∧ 0 < T.vol ∧ ∑ o, T.facet o = 0

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._abel_1_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._abel_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._abel_1_1.type: ∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (b c : Fin (d + 1)), T.x b - T.x c = T.x b - T.x 0 - (T.x c - T.x 0)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_4.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_4.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_5.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus._simp_1_5.type: ∀ {α : Sort u_1} {a b : α}, (a = b) = (b = a)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.casesOn.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.casesOn
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.casesOn.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) → ((x : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) → motive { x := x }) → motive t

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.centroid.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.centroid.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.centroid.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), T.centroid = (1 / (↑d + 1)) • ∑ a, T.x a

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Num.Simplex d → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.edgeMat.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (α β : Fin d), T.edgeMat α β = T.x β.succ α - T.x 0 α

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Num.Simplex d → Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (o : Fin (d + 1)), T.facet o = -(↑d * T.vol) • T.grad o

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.type:
(∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
        T.facet o = (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2) else 1 / 2) • nv) ∧
  ∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
          [o', a', b', c'].Nodup →
            T'.x a' = T.x a →
              T'.x b' = T.x b →
                T'.x c' = T.x c →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
                  CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) * CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T'.x o' - T.x a) < 0 →
                    T'.facet o' = -T.facet o

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -1 else 1) •
          CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Num.Simplex d → Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.grad.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (a : Fin (d + 1)),
  T.grad a = Fin.cases (-∑ β, fun α => T.edgeMat⁻¹ β α) (fun β α => T.edgeMat⁻¹ β α) a

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (δ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ),
  1 ≤ d →
    T.Nondeg →
      ∑ a, δ a = 0 →
        ((∀ (a b : Fin (d + 1)), a ≠ b → δ a • T.grad b + δ b • T.grad a = 0) ↔ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), δ a = 0)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.inj.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.inj
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.inj.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} {x x_1 : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d}, { x := x } = { x := x_1 } → x = x_1

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.injEq
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.injEq.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x x_1 : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d), ({ x := x } = { x := x_1 }) = (x = x_1)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.noConfusion
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.noConfusion.type: {d : ℕ} → {P : Sort u} → {x x' : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d} → { x := x } = { x := x' } → (x ≍ x' → P) → P

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.sizeOf_spec
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.mk.sizeOf_spec.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d), sizeOf { x := x } = 1

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      ∑ k, ((1 / 2) • (F i + F k)).mulVec (M.n i k) = ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) ∧
        ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) =
          ∑ T, ∑ a, if (M.vert T) a = i then (M.ω T * M.m T) • ∑ b, (F ((M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b) else 0

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
          (∀ (i k : ι),
              M.B i k =
                ∑ p,
                  if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                    ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                  else 0) ∧
            ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i) ∧
      ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = 2 * ↑d * M.volΩ ∧
        (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → 2 * ↑d * M.V i ≤ (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace) ∧
          ∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i → ((M.Gtensor M.n i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i ↔ ∀ (k : ι), ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ M.n i k = t • M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * M.mu i k) ∧
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∃ T a b, (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k ∧ 0 < M.ω T) →
            0 < M.mu i k ∧
              (∃ t, 0 < t ∧ M.nu i k = t • M.e i k) ∧
                CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) = CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) / CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (σ : ι → ι → ℝ) (s σmax h : ℝ) (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    0 < M.V i →
      let K := fun z =>
        (1 / (4 * M.V i)) • ∑ k, (σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (z i k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k);
      ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → K y = (s / (4 * M.V i)) • M.Gtensor y i) ∧
        ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → (K M.nu).trace = ↑d * s / 2) ∧
          ((∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ i k ∧ σ i k ≤ σmax) →
            (∀ (k : ι), M.n i k ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) ≤ h) → (K M.nu).trace ≤ ↑d / 2 * σmax * h)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.type:
∀ (ι C Q : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q]
  (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (fq : Q → C × Fin (d + 1)) (aq : Q → ℝ)
  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                  bd p = true →
                    ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                      ∀ k ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                        (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i * φ q k else 0) =
                          (1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) →
                let N := fun q => aq q • M.areaVec (fq q);
                (∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i) ∧ ∀ (i k : ι), ∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q = M.B i k

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      (M.Conforming bd → M.FacetBalanced bd) ∧
        (M.FacetBalanced bd →
          (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
            (∀ (i k : ι),
                M.B i k =
                  ∑ p,
                    if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                      ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                    else 0) ∧
              ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entropy
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (w : ι → κ → ℝ) (ψ : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (Fs : C × Fin (d + 1) → ι → κ → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j • Fs p j else 0;
        ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (b i)) =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true then
              1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.areaVec p) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (Fs p i)) +
                1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) *
                  ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (Fs p j - Fs p i)
            else 0

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι),
            ∑ k, (F k).mulVec ((1 / 2) • (M.B i k + if i = k then M.beta i else 0)) =
              ∑ p,
                if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                  ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j • (F j).mulVec (M.areaVec p)
                else 0) ∧
          ∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i i = (↑d + 3) * CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j

∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (e y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (σ : ι → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  0 < V →
    (∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ k) →
      (∀ (k : ι), 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) →
        let K := fun z => (1 / (4 * V)) • ∑ k, (σ k * CFDLean.Num.len (z k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k);
        let ν := fun k => CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nuOf (y k) (e k);
        (∀ (k : ι),
            CFDLean.Num.len (y k) =
                CFDLean.Num.len (ν k) * (CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
              1 ≤ CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
          (K y - K ν).PosSemidef ∧ (K y = K ν ↔ ∀ (k : ι), 0 < σ k → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ y k = t • e k)

CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_conserva.name: CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_conservation
CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_conserva.type:
∀ (ι S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ)
  (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (u : ι → S) (ut : ι → κ → ℝ) (lam eps2 eps4 : ι → ι → ℝ) (Nstar : ι → Finset ι)
  (b : ι → κ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i k : ι), n k i = -n i k) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = Fec b a y) →
      (∀ (a b : S), IsLinearMap ℝ (Fec a b)) →
        (∀ (i k : ι), lam k i = lam i k) →
          (∀ (i k : ι), eps2 k i = eps2 i k) →
            (∀ (i k : ι), eps4 k i = eps4 i k) →
              let L := fun i => ∑ k ∈ Nstar i, (ut k - ut i);
              let F := fun i k =>
                Fec (u i) (u k) (n i k) + lam i k • (eps2 i k • (ut i - ut k) - eps4 i k • (L i - L k));
              (∀ (i k : ι), F k i = -F i k) ∧ ∑ i, (-∑ k, F i k - b i) = -∑ i, b i

CFDLean.Num.dualFacets_grad.name: CFDLean.Num.dualFacets_grad
CFDLean.Num.dualFacets_grad.type:
(∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
    0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p →
      (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).Nondeg ∧
        (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).vol = CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p ∧
          ∀ (i k : Fin 4),
            CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i k =
              ((CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).vol / 4) •
                ((CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).grad k - (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).grad i)) ∧
  ∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
    T.Nondeg → ∀ (i k : Fin 3), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dualFacet2 T i k = (T.vol / 3) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split.name: CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split
CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split.type:
∀ (ι κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (c B : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (β : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, c i k = 0) →
    (∀ (k : ι), ∑ i, c i k = β k) →
      (∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, B i k = β i) →
        let n := fun i k => c i k - c k i;
        let s := fun i k => (1 / 2) • (c i k + c k i - B i k);
        ∀ (i : ι),
          ∑ k, ((1 / 2) • (F i + F k)).mulVec (n i k) + ∑ k, (F k - F i).mulVec (s i k) +
              (1 / 2) • (∑ k, (F k).mulVec (B i k) + (F i).mulVec (β i)) =
            ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (c i k)

CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split._sim.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, ∑ x ∈ s, r • f x = r • ∑ x ∈ s, f x

CFDLean.Num.entropyConservative_producti.name: CFDLean.Num.entropyConservative_production
CFDLean.Num.entropyConservative_producti.type:
∀ (ι S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (w : S → κ → ℝ) (ψ : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (u : ι → S),
  (∀ (i k : ι), n k i = -n i k) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = Fec b a y) →
      (∀ (a b : S), IsLinearMap ℝ (Fec a b)) →
        (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b - w a) (Fec a b y) = CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ b - ψ a) y) →
          let beta := fun i => -∑ k, n i k;
          let Rc := fun i => ∑ k, Fec (u i) (u k) (n i k);
          -∑ i, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (u i)) (Rc i) = 1 / 2 * ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u k) - ψ (u i)) (n i k) ∧
            1 / 2 * ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u k) - ψ (u i)) (n i k) = ∑ i, CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u i)) (beta i)

CFDLean.Num.facetSide.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Num.facetSide.congr_simp
CFDLean.Num.facetSide.congr_simp.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] {inst_1 : DecidableEq ι} [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : LinearOrder ι]
  [inst_4 : Fintype C] (M M_1 : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3),
  M = M_1 → ∀ (p p_1 : C × Fin 4), p = p_1 → CFDLean.Num.facetSide M p = CFDLean.Num.facetSide M_1 p_1

CFDLean.Num.facetSide.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.facetSide.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.facetSide.eq_1.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3) (p : C × Fin 4),
  CFDLean.Num.facetSide M p =
    ↑(SignType.sign
        (CFDLean.Num.dot
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3
            (M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 1 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)) -
              M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)))
            (M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 2 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)) -
              M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2))))
          (M.pos ((M.vert p.1) p.2) - M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)))))

CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.name: CFDLean.Num.facetSide2
CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.type: {ι C : Type} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → [LinearOrder ι] → [Fintype C] → CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2 → C × Fin 3 → ℝ

CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.congr_simp
CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.congr_simp.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] {inst_1 : DecidableEq ι} [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : LinearOrder ι]
  [inst_4 : Fintype C] (M M_1 : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2),
  M = M_1 → ∀ (p p_1 : C × Fin 3), p = p_1 → CFDLean.Num.facetSide2 M p = CFDLean.Num.facetSide2 M_1 p_1

CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.facetSide2.eq_1.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2) (p : C × Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Num.facetSide2 M p =
    ↑(SignType.sign
        (CFDLean.Num.dot
          (CFDLean.Num.perp2
            (M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 1 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)) -
              M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2))))
          (M.pos ((M.vert p.1) p.2) - M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)))))

CFDLean.Num.logMean.eq_1.type: ∀ (a b : ℝ), CFDLean.Num.logMean a b = if a = b then a else (b - a) / (Real.log b - Real.log a)

CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties.name: CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties
CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      CFDLean.Num.logMean a b = CFDLean.Num.logMean b a ∧
        CFDLean.Num.logMean a a = a ∧
          0 < CFDLean.Num.logMean a b ∧ b - a = CFDLean.Num.logMean a b * (Real.log b - Real.log a)

CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral.name: CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral
CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral.type:
∀ (κ : Type) [inst : Fintype κ] (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) (B : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] κ → ℝ) (wi wk : κ → ℝ),
  (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, HasFDerivAt Φ (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wi + s • (wk - wi))) →
    ContinuousOn (fun s => (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi)) (Set.Icc 0 1) →
      Φ wk - Φ wi = ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..1, (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi) ∧
        CFDLean.Num.pairF (wk - wi) (Φ wk - Φ wi) =
          ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..1, CFDLean.Num.pairF (wk - wi) ((B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi))

CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse.type:

        a ≠ b → CFDLean.Num.dot ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a) ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad b) ≤ 0

CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion
CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion.type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (x : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι) (lam : ι → ℝ) (V q0 : ℝ)
  (gq : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  V ≠ 0 →
    H.IsSymm →
      let q := fun z => q0 + CFDLean.Num.dot gq z + 1 / 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot z (H.mulVec z);
      let K := (1 / (4 * V)) • ∑ k, lam k • CFDLean.Num.outer (x k - x i) (x k - x i);
      1 / 2 * ∑ k, lam k * (q (x k) - q (x i)) =
        1 / 2 * ∑ k, lam k * CFDLean.Num.dot (gq + H.mulVec (x i)) (x k - x i) + V * CFDLean.Num.frob K H

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (w : S → κ → ℝ)
  (ψ : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → ℝ),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = Fec b a y) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b - w a) (Fec a b y) = CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ b - ψ a) y) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (q : Q), w (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • w (u k)) →
          let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
          let b := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + Fs q);
          ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u i)) (beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (u i)) (b i)) =
              ∑ q, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (ut q)) (N q) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (ut q)) (Fs q)) ∧
            ∑ i, b i = ∑ q, Fs q

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._abel_1_2
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → ℝ) (q : Q),
  ∑ x, φ q x • Fec (ut q) (u x) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + Fs q = Fs q

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._s.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._s.type:

  [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {f : ι → R} {s : Finset ι} {x : M}, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • x = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • x

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ)
  (phys : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (U : S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a b : S), IsLinearMap ℝ (Fec a b)) →
    (∀ (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec U U y = phys U y) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = -∑ k, n i k) →
          let b := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec U U (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec U U (N q) + phys U (N q));
          ∀ (i : ι), -∑ k, Fec U U (n i k) - b i = 0

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ)
  (Fl : S → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = ((1 / 2) • (Fl a + Fl b)).mulVec y) →
    (∀ (q : Q), Fl (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • Fl (u k)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + (Fl (ut q)).mulVec (N q));
        ∀ (i : ι), b i = (1 / 2) • ((Fl (u i)).mulVec (beta i) + ∑ k, (Fl (u k)).mulVec (∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q))

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_8

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) +
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (a : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x fun i => a * n i) = a • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n -
      CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n =
    n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
      n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x =
    (γ - 1) •
      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
              CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
        (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formula
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = (γ - 1) * (x 4 - (x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) / (2 * x 0))

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.type:

  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i = (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i / x 0

CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.eq_1.type:

  CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W =

CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.B γ z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(2 * z 0) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0,
        z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1,
        z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2,
        z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3,
        (1 / γ) •
          (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
            (γ - 1) •
              (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))]
